Parsing HTML Streams in Python

This tutorial shows how to parse a response stream while keeping memory bounded and preserving code fences for Agent-readable Markdown.

def iter_chunks(response):
    for chunk in response.aiter_content():
        if chunk:
            yield chunk

The key rule is to count bytes before decoding text, because a compressed or malformed response can otherwise exhaust memory.

  1. Declare a maximum body size.
  2. Close the stream when a limit is exceeded.
  3. Decode only after the byte cap has passed.
